mapper.select: SELECT dev_id AS "id",jncmp_dt AS "hireDate",retire_dt AS "retireDate",work_stat_cd AS "status",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT dev_id FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT stat_sn AS "sn",work_stat_cd AS "state",bgn_dt AS "startDate",end_dt AS "endDate",stat_rsn AS "reason", close_leave_sn AS "closeLeaveSn",orgnl_leave_end_dt AS "originalLeaveEndDate",reg_user_id AS "regUserId", reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY bgn_dt DESC,stat_sn DESC

SELECT a.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=a.proj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT user_nm FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_id=#{actor}
SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT close_ym FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE' ORDER BY close_ym

SELECT greatest(coalesce((SELECT max(stat_sn) FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{id}),0), coalesce((SELECT max(substring(trgt_key FROM length(#{id})+2)::numeric) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_HR_DEV_STAT' AND left(trgt_key,length(#{id})+1)=#{id}||':' AND substring(trgt_key FROM length(#{id})+2) ~ '^[0-9]{1,5}$'),0))::integer
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_dev_stat SET end_dt=#{row.endDate},close_leave_sn=#{row.closeLeaveSn},orgnl_leave_end_dt=#{row.originalLeaveEndDate},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND stat_sn=#{row.sn}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_hr_dev_stat WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND stat_sn=#{sn} AND work_stat_cd IN ('WORK','RETIRE')
